title: What 10 Markets Autocomplete: 43,005 Suggestions
subtitle: 3 topics x 10 English-speaking markets x 4 engines: how much overlap?

resources.description: Every suggestion as collected: 43,005 rows of seed, market, engine, query, rank in the suggestion list, keyword, rule-based intent and word count.
One row per distinct keyword (5,557): which of the 10 markets and which of the 4 engines suggested it, plus its best rank anywhere.
All 135 market pairs (45 pairs x 3 seeds) with shared and union keyword counts, symmetric Jaccard overlap and a directional share.
Per seed and pooled: each engine's reach, how much of its output nothing else suggested, and what a Google-only tool would miss.

userSpecifiedSources: Google, YouTube, Bing and DuckDuckGo public suggestion endpoints, collected with the Long Tail Keyword Questions actor on Apify: https://apify.com/bhole_krishna/keyword-demand-scraper
